`paragraphs-and-table.docx` is Mammoth's `test/test-data/tables.docx` fixture
from version 1.11.0. It contains two paragraphs and a two-by-two table in between.
The upstream BSD license is retained in `MAMMOTH-LICENSE`.

`paragraphs-and-lists.docx` is a locally authored OOXML document containing body
paragraphs, a nested bullet list, a numbered list, and a bullet list inside a table
cell. Its list items use Word numbering definitions rather than literal markers.
It contains no external resources.

`pages.pdf` is a locally generated, uncompressed three-page fixture containing
“First page”, “Second page”, and an empty page. It has no external resources.
